Predicting effects from signed weight changes

Result: the fixed decoder failed. It classified every real update as no detectable change: 0/64 complete descriptions correct. Unchanged LoRAcle scored 1/64 and the previous component decoder scored 13/64. All eight zero controls were correct.

Its mean predicted effect span was 0.00317 nats/token versus 0.52089 measured. The profile error relative to predicting zero was 0.995. The untouched tests remain sealed. Interpretation and next decision · Post-run diagnosis

This supervised decoder learns all 32 measured effect scores from exact physical weight changes. It uses every original training example, one fixed regularization rule, and no development fitting. The complete predicted pattern remains the primary score. It is a different weight-based method, not a successful LoRAcle fine-tune.

All cases and controls remain. Untouched tests have not been run.
